name: Q0bp: coordination with no owners, across a partition
about: q0b with a1 cut off (no network, feed stopped) from 0.45 to 1.6, just after the change request lands at 0.3: a1 decides who builds it on what it knew before the cut, the others decide without hearing from a1. Tests conflicting claims made on both sides of a partition: claims (one lead by the same rule when they meet) against a TASKS.md board.
brief: **This is a very short run (about 3 minutes of work).** The planner already works and `npm test` passes. Shortly after you start, the product manager lands a change request (`CHANGE-REQUEST.md` on main, and a `- [pm] CHANGE REQUEST ...` line in NOTES.md). Nobody is assigned: the team decides who does what. Build it once, between you, without stepping on each other. Your network may drop for a while; keep going.

roles.a1: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a2: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**
roles.a3: **You work on the whole codebase; there are no module owners.**

stop: Stop as soon as the change request is on main and `npm test` passes there, or at minute 3 (`date` against when you started), whichever comes first. Don't wait for teammates to finish.
